_comment: Experiment 11 ground truth. 25 queries spanning three layout categories (two_column, single_column, table_heavy) per openspec/changes/use-liteparse-as-pdf-reader tasks 2.4 and 3.2. Entry schema: {query_id, query, expected_files, expected_pages, category}. query_id is added for run_eval.py traceability (the runner reads it via .get); the four spec-required fields (query, expected_files, expected_pages, category) are all present. Page numbers reference the arXiv PDF versions committed in corpus/ and should be spot-checked before running the experiment. Written blind per /s-experiment discipline: do NOT edit queries after build_indexes.py runs.
